subject: Re: Evidence request — secure SDLC snapshot and CI/change-control artifacts
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@remitbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: RemitBank Security <security-review@remitbank.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Evidence request — secure SDLC snapshot and CI/change-control artifacts

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 / SIG intake for Redwood we need a compact evidence bundle focused on secure SDLC controls: code review gating, CI/CD controls, secrets management (short-lived tokens, KMS/HSM usage), and change-management (approval trails, rollback playbooks). To keep the assessor efficient, could you provide: 

- A sampling of PRs (IDs + links) across the last 6 months with reviewer approvals and merged timestamps (sanitized if necessary).
- CI pipeline artifacts (build logs, job names, timestamps) showing successful builds and signature/verification steps.
- Branch protection rules and who can bypass (list of roles).
- Evidence of ephemeral secret issuance (Vault/AWS STS), KMS usage for signing or key custody, and the last 90 days of rotation policy.
- Change management trail: who approved deploys, runbook links, and an example rollback execution log.

If you can deliver a redacted zip + an index and a short narrative (1 page) describing sampling methodology by Friday 21 Jun, that would be ideal. If any items require an NDA or redaction conversation, flag them and we can schedule a brief call.

Best,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Engineer — RemitBank
security-review@remitbank.com

Attachments: N/A

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@remitbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jun 2029 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence request — secure SDLC snapshot and CI/change-control artifacts

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a tightly scoped package that meets your assessor needs. Plan below (mutual action plan):

1) By end of day 20 Jun: deliver an "artifact index" PDF + a redacted ZIP with sampled PR metadata (CSV), sanitized CI logs (ZIP), and a short narrative describing our sampling methodology.
2) By 21 Jun: provide Vault and KMS usage summaries and a short runbook excerpt for rollback (sanitized).
3) If assessor needs live context, we can run a 30-minute walkthrough the week of 24 Jun.

Quick notes on scope: we will sample ~30 PRs (stratified across backend, infra, and model-serving repos) and include reviewer IDs, approver timestamps, and merge commit SHAs. Build logs will be sanitized to remove any customer data — we will keep pipeline job names and elapsed times, plus the step that performs signature verification. Branch protection rules and role bypass list will be exported from Git provider and redacted for personal emails.

Attachments to come: proofchain-artifact-index-20290620.pdf; ci-build-logs-sanitized-20290618.zip; pr-sample-manifest-20290620.csv

Irene, Jordan — looping you in for the Vault/KMS summaries and to confirm the PR sample export.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

--

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@remitbank.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 11:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence request — secure SDLC snapshot and CI/change-control artifacts

Alice / Sofia — following up with clarifications and a few artifacts now live in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cProofchainIndex (read-only). The index (proofchain-artifact-index-20290620.pdf) lists each file and a short justification for why it was included.

Clarifications: 
- PR sampling: we used stratified random sampling by repo criticality. The CSV includes PR number, title, author (redacted to role), reviewer role, approvals, and merge commit. We will not include full diffs in the initial package; those can be provided under a tighter NDA if the assessor requires.
- CI pipelines: names are redwood-build, redwood-infra, redwood-modelserve. The sanitized logs include the verification step where we call our sigstore-backed signer to attach provenance metadata.
- Secrets: we issue short-lived credentials via HashiCorp Vault with a 1h TTL for runners and rotate service keys monthly. KMS is used for signing and long-term key custody; HSM-backed signing is used for release artifacts. The attached vault-ephemeral-summary-20290620.docx explains token issuance flow and audit hooks.
- Change management: our deploy approvals are handled via the "deploy-approvals" board (internal Jira ID provided in the index) and all production rollouts require two approvers from different teams. The runbook excerpt contains the rollback checklist and an example incident with timestamps (redacted).

Attachments (in Drive + included ZIP): ci-build-logs-sanitized-20290618.zip; pr-sample-manifest-20290620.csv; vault-ephemeral-summary-20290620.docx; proofchain-artifact-index-20290620.pdf

If you want a single consolidated PDF attestation from our security leadership confirming the methodology and redaction approach, we can produce that before the Friday deadline.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Sofia / Irene — appreciate the rapid turnaround and the Drive index. This looks like the right scope. A couple quick asks before we close the intake: 

- Please include a one-paragraph attestation (signed PDF) from your security leadership that confirms the redaction methodology and confirms no customer data is present in the artifacts.
- Can you add the HubSpot intake ID to the index (we have HS-Case-45321) and paste a short mapping of the PR sample to internal business domains (infra / model / api) so the assessor can sample across functional areas?

We'd also like to book a 30-minute walkthrough Friday 21 Jun at 10:00 PT if that works for your team. If yes, please send a calendar invite (or confirm and we'll send).

Thanks again — we'll mark this as on-track pending the attestation and the mapping.

Best regards,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Engineer — RemitBank
security-review@remitbank.com
